revisit.item: A farm stand raised the price of a jar of honey by 20 percent in June and then lowered the new price by 20 percent in September. In December it raised the September price by $p$ percent, which brought the price back exactly to its original value. To the nearest tenth, what is $p$? · choices: $0.0$ / $4.0$ / $4.2$ / $4.8$ / $20.0$
revisit.setup: price up p% then down q% (or back to a reference); find the missing percent or value
revisit.change: keep the insight but move the trap: a different wrong path should tempt
